title: GoToCenter
description: Teleports you to the center of the block you are standing on.
body:
# GoToCenter
This very simple plugin teleports you to the center of the block you are standing on.

Use the command `/center` to teleport to the exact middle of the block you are standing on.
When creating NPCs or holograms, you often want it to be located in the exact middle of the block. This plugin allows you to fastly go to the middle of any block, instead of having to use the `/teleport <~.5> <y> <~.5>` command.
